question: In which of the following states is the ‘Jhora’ dance performed as a springtime celebration?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Jhora dance is performed in the state of Uttarakhand as a springtime celebration**
 
• The J**hora dance originated in the Kumaon region of Uttarakhand. **
 
• The Jhora **dance is typically performed in the spring season**. 
 
• The Jhora dance **is also performed at weddings, festivals, and fairs. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Community dance: **The Jhora dance is a community dance that brings together people of all castes. 
 
• **Dance moves: **The Jhora dance involves men and women moving in a circle, holding hands, and slightly bending forward.
 
 
• Each step is taken with a slight jump and accompanied by neck and shoulder movements. 
 
 
 
• **Traditional drum:** The Jhora dance is performed to the accompaniment of the traditional drum, known as the "Hurka".
